segs.text: The perfect formula to make money. Islam gave it to us fourteen hundred years ago.
One. Earn it with your own hands.
Two. Never lie to make a sale.
Three. Give some of it away.
The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: Charity does not decrease wealth.
Four. Leave the result to Allah.
Work. Honesty. Charity. Trust. That is the formula.
Send this to someone building a business.
